verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine. Weights stream from the local SSD to run 35B MoE models in about 2.5 GB of RAM, and a single fetched download is a ready-to-run model. It serves an OpenAI-compatible API on 127.0.0.1 and ships on-device apps for iOS, Android, Windows and macOS, so inference runs on the user's own hardware. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no telemetry or prompt data leaves the device, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fully offline operation.
